title: Restricted Parallel MultiSWAP Committed-Boundary Restart Composition
goal: Qualify composition of the already-canonical restricted parallel real-physics MultiSWAP V1 execution path with the already-canonical committed-boundary process restart contract, without adding new physics or a second transaction implementation.
hard_gates: continuous parallel two-window execution equals parallel restart continuation by column id
worker-count transition across restart does not enter persistent state
hard per-window and cumulative mass continuation
restart bundle contains no worker assignment, solver workspace or scratch
fresh-runtime restore is atomic and fail closed
one bad late record leaves all target committed states uninitialized
unsupported parallel physics fails before physical solve after restore

source_policy.reason: F-CI28 restart and F-CI30 parallel execution are already canonical; this workunit is composition qualification first.
source_policy.if_source_change_becomes_necessary: stop, persist blocker, reconcile ownership, and do not silently modify canonical production source

explicit_nonclaims: root-extraction/snow/macropore/frost or other excluded parallel physics
